With template.language set, the judge is asked for every menu label in that language and every label it returns is written; without it the judge keeps the old question. A link, button, or header/footer item that leads to an unticked page is removed, not relinked to the contact page; a contract slot button is hidden through blockVisibility; child pages and posts of an unticked page are drafted (Tracy Base WP 1.1.2 fixtures). A two-edition Joomla site (Tracy Business) written in one language other than en-GB calls sourceLanguage.set with written: true after multilingual.retire, writes the footer module titles in that language, and a plugin without that door leaves a note while the words are still written. Joomla articles of a category whose page was unticked are unpublished.
